## Template Used

LACDR-ISA - Assay (General) v1.0.0

## Title

`r rmarkdown::metadata$title`

## Date (dd-MM-yyyy)

`r format(Sys.time(), format = "%d-%m-%Y")`

## Description or Purpose

Show correlation between EMT phenotype and subtype

### Data sources

-   Metadata on cell line phenotypes

## Results

### Preparations

#### Load R libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

#### Visualization settings for the report

```{r}
options(digits = 3) # visualizations of tables
theme_set(theme_classic())
```

#### Custom functions

```{r}
source(here("code/functions/helpers.R"))
source(here("code/functions/figure_helpers.R"))
source(here("code/functions/color_scales.R"))
```

#### Set input and output directories

Show base path to the project that is used in the analysis.

```{r}
here()
```

Set output data directory and create if it does not exist.

```{r}
source(here("code/functions/helpers.R"))
```

```{r}
datestamp <- get_datestamp()
output_dir <- set_output_dir(here("manuscript", str_glue("Supplementary_Figures_{datestamp}")))
```

### Load data

```{r}
# Metadata on cell line names
data_dir <- here("data", "figure_1")
cell_line_metadata <- read_csv(here("data/cell_line_metadata.csv"))
dim(cell_line_metadata)
head(cell_line_metadata)
```

#### Build plot

```{r}
#| fig-height: 2
#| fig-width: 3
p <- cell_line_metadata |>
  ggplot(aes(x = EMT_score, y = ProliferationRate, color = Subtype_4_categories)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_legend_Subtype) +
  labs(x = "EMT score", y = "proliferation rate (70/doubling time)", color = "Subtype") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
p
```

Save to file.

```{r}
save_plot(
  here(output_dir, str_c("Supplementary_Figure_1.png")),
  plot = p,
  base_height = cm_to_inch(5),
  base_width = cm_to_inch(7))
```
